programme.desc: To fuel his political ambitions, Vijay's father fixes his marriage with an affluent girl. However, after Vijay falls for an ordinary villager and plans on marrying her, his father plans to stop him.

programme.title: Geet
programme.desc: After losing her ability to sing, Neha, a famous star, relocates to a small village. While she attempts to get back her voice, she encounters Rajesh, who decides to help her.

programme.title: Aakhri Ghulam
programme.desc: Bheema, his father Dinu and generations of their family have been slaves of the wealthy Thakurs. One day, he challenges their authority and invites trouble for himself in the process.

programme.title: Krishna Arjun
programme.desc: Sharda Yadav, a widow, lives with her two sons, Krishna and Arjun. Arjun is studying in Mumbai when he hears that his mother has passed away and Krishna has been arrested for raping a widow.

programme.title: Aar Ya Paar
programme.desc: Shekhar is having an affair with Anu, his wealthy wife's secretary. When the wife finds out, they kill her. The police then find evidence against him, and he learns that Anu is likely to betray him.

programme.title: Dhadkan
programme.desc: Anjali and Dev are in love with each other and plan to marry, but her family gets her married to Ram. Years later, Dev shows up to reunite with Anjali, however, she has fallen in love with Ram.

programme.title: 7th Day
programme.desc: When two friends run into David, an IPS official, they reveal an unfortunate event that changed their lives. David helps them get out of the mess but he is not what he claims to be.

programme.title: Blood Relation
programme.desc: Full of action and drama.

programme.title: Pyar Ki Kahani
programme.desc: Ram, a peon, forms a close friendship with a man named Ravi and values his opinion. However, he is shocked when Ravi disapproves of his fiancee and gets more upset when he learns the reason why.

programme.title: Gurudev
programme.desc: Inspector Dev Kumar has to choose between arresting his childhood friend Guru's father, who is a notorious criminal, and his integrity.

programme.title: Teri Kasam
programme.desc: Dolly, a rich and spoilt woman, falls for Tony, a poor musician, and marries him. However, her arrogance begins to create problems in their marital life.

programme.title: Keemat
programme.desc: Two crooks accidentally kill a man and decide to inform his parents about the bad news. However, once they meet the family, they end up lying to them.

programme.title: Jaan Se Pyaara

programme.desc: This programme presents masterpieces of classical Japanese literature - in both original forms and modern translations - with easy-to-understand imagery that conveys the world view of ancient Japan.

programme.desc: Tornado: Tornadoes are among nature's fiercest forces. Experts reveal how they form, while survivors in Kentucky and Missouri recount their fight to stay alive. (S1, ep 1)

programme.title: Shark With Steve Backshall
programme.desc: Sharks of the Atlantic Ocean: Join Steve as he grants a rare glimpse into the secret life of sharks in the Atlantic Ocean. (S1, ep 1)

programme.title: Shark With Steve Backshall
programme.desc: Sharks of the Indian Ocean: Join Steve as he finds out how sharks in the Indian Ocean are adapting to their rapidly changing world. (S1, ep 2)

programme.title: Shark With Steve Backshall
programme.desc: Sharks of the Pacific Ocean: Join Steve as he tracks down 'shark hotspots' in the Pacific Ocean and works out how to protect them. (S1, ep 3)

programme.title: Shark: British Isles Special...
programme.desc: ...with Steve Backshall: Steve explores a world of sharks right on your doorstep and films the Angelshark for the first time, discovering the threats they face.

programme.title: Great Barrier Reef With David Attenborough
programme.desc: Builders: David Attenborough descends beneath the waves and meets some of the tiny coral animals that helped build the Reef and make it an underwater wonderland. (1 of 3)

programme.title: Great Barrier Reef With David Attenborough
programme.desc: Visitors: Mark Sir David Attenborough's 100th birthday as he explores the Great Barrier Reef, and discovers the animals that visit every year. (2 of 3)

programme.title: Great Barrier Reef With David Attenborough
programme.desc: Survival: In this concluding episode, Sir David Attenborough tries to understand what the next few decades may hold in store for the Reef. (3 of 3)

programme.title: Attenborough's Journey at 100
programme.desc: Mark Sir David Attenborough's 100th birthday with this documentary reflecting on his extraordinary career and the legacy of his groundbreaking storytelling across the world.

programme.title: The Great Elephant Tale
programme.desc: Three stories of one of nature's most iconic species. A calf navigates the Okavango Delta, a bull searches for a mate, and a matriarch leads her family through the desert.

programme.title: World's Most Toxic Animals
programme.desc: Deserts & Oceans: In Australia, meet the world's most venomous snake. Plus, in nearby oceans, discover the deadly nature of the marine creatures that share these tropical waters. (1 of 2)

programme.title: World's Most Toxic Animals
programme.desc: Forest & Grasslands: In the South American rainforest, there's a tiny frog that's packed with poison. While near Sydney, Australia, you'll meet the world's most venomous spider. (2 of 2)

programme.title: Africa's Hunters
programme.desc: The Misfits: When the runt of the Nsefu pride's new litter gets dangerously separated, it's his shy character and his mother's love that saves his life. (S1, ep 4)

programme.title: Beasts Of The Big Blue
programme.desc: Tini Heke / Snares Islands: Explore the pristine wilderness of Snares Island with its colony of Snares Crested Penguins, soar with giant petrels and swim with giant sea lions. (1 of 6)

programme.title: Beasts Of The Big Blue
programme.desc: Muaupoko/ Otago Peninsula: Join sea lions, albatrosses, red-billed gulls and fairy prions on New Zealand's Otago Peninsula as they find mates and nurture the next generation. (2 of 6)

programme.title: Dogs With Extraordinary Jobs
programme.desc: The Rescuers: Dogs are coming to our rescue in surprising ways, including this Great Dane that has transformed the life of a 13-year-old girl with a life-limiting condition. (S1, ep 1)

programme.title: Dogs With Extraordinary Jobs
programme.desc: The Lifesavers: Across the world, dogs are saving lives. At a South African airport, bird-chasing border collies are preventing potentially devastating collisions with aircraft. (S1, ep 2)

programme.title: Extraordinary Animals
programme.desc: Playful: The animals of Australia work hard to ensure survival. Sometimes working hard isn't always smart. A playful approach can be just as important. (S2, ep 7)

programme.title: Extraordinary Animals
programme.desc: Sinister: Australia has a reputation for the most sinister animals on earth. Behind each sinister trait lies a clever means of survival. (S2, ep 8)

programme.title: Matsalu Moose: Wild Giants Of The Baltics
programme.desc: Matsalu National Park is home to an exceptionally large moose colony. Join two yearlings as they roam the open marshes and thrive in this extraordinary moose kingdom.

programme.title: Macaque Island
programme.desc: The Young Up-Start: Explore the treed cityscape where Matnoor rules over the 30-member-strong Street Troop, before meeting Aarav - the wilder Hill Troop's old alpha. (S1, ep 1)

programme.title: Macaque Island
programme.desc: The Grass is Greener: The Hill Troop invade the Street Troop's turf, before the Sisterhood plots to kidnap Sara's baby. Meanwhile, alpha Loci discovers his old rival is back. (S1, ep 2)

programme.title: Macaque Island
programme.desc: Clash of the Alphas: Stand back as a brawl erupts after the Street Troop finds the Hill Troop on their turf, before alpha wannabe Ajit makes his move. (S1, ep 3)

programme.title: Battle Of The Alphas
programme.desc: New & Exclusive. Come face-to-face with alphas who use might to subdue enemies, from sea lions and cape buffalo to Canada geese and lionesses. (S2, ep 9)

programme.title: Battle Of The Alphas
programme.desc: New & Exclusive. Meet the ugliest alphas of the animal world, from warthogs and giant African bullfrogs to wild turkeys and Nile crocodiles. (S2, ep 10)

programme.title: Accidental Wilderness: Europe's Everglades
programme.desc: It was once a former wasteland where an entire city's wastewater used to be deposited. Now, it's a paradise for birds migrating from across the continent and beyond.

programme.title: In For The Kill
programme.desc: It's one of the most dramatic moments in nature - a predator claiming its prey. But how have these creatures adapted to achieve these epic feats of speed, cunning and agility?

programme.title: Predators
programme.desc: Lion: Journey to Okavango Delta as the Matata Pride battle wildfires and flooding in a fight to keep their cubs alive. (3 of 5)

programme.title: David Attenborough's Galapagos
programme.desc: Origin: Mark Sir David Attenborough's 100th birthday week by joining him on his travels to the Galapagos as he charted the archipelago's rise from the ocean millions of years ago. (1 of 3)

programme.title: David Attenborough's Galapagos
programme.desc: Adaptation: In celebration of his 100th birthday, join Sir David Attenborough as he discovered unique species, showing how life adapted to the islands' shifting landscapes. (2 of 3)

programme.title: David Attenborough's Galapagos
programme.desc: Evolution: Celebrate Sir David Attenborough's 100th birthday as he explored unusual Galapagos species, including giant tortoise Lonesome George. (3 of 3)

programme.title: New: Violent Earth
programme.desc: Wildfire: Discover how small fires become unstoppable megafires. Experts and survivors relive disasters including Yarnell Hill and Lahaina. (S1, ep 2)

programme.title: Rise Of Animals With David Attenborough
programme.desc: From The Seas To The Skies: To celebrate David Attenborough's 100th birthday, join him when he unravelled the rise of the vertebrates and explored their origins. (1 of 2)

programme.title: Rise Of Animals With David Attenborough
programme.desc: Dawn Of The Mammals: To celebrate David Attenborough's 100th birthday, join him when he revealed the meteoric rise of mammals from their humble origins.(2 of 2)

programme.title: Survival Of The Beast
programme.desc: Desert-Adapted Elephant: Max Djenohan embarks on a mission to unlock and mimic the survival skills of some of the most charismatic animals on Earth. (S1, ep 1)
